description: Write smartVISU pages faster: all widgets of your smartVISU version with parameter help, SmartHomeNG items as suggestions, page structure as snippets, checks for unknown widgets and items
config.version: smartVISU version whose widgets and parameters are used. `auto` reads the version from `version-info.php` of the smartVISU installation (otherwise the newest bundled version is used).
config.version.installed: Read the widgets directly from the installation's `widgets/` folder (e.g. for development versions)
config.installPath: Path of the smartVISU installation (folder with `version-info.php`, `widgets/`, `pages/`), e.g. `\\smarthomeng\smartvisu`. Empty: searched upwards from the opened page.
config.url: Web address of the smartVISU installation, e.g. `http://smarthomeng/smartvisu` – for links to the documentation that comes with it. Empty: derived from the network path of the installation (`\\server\smartvisu` → `http://server/smartvisu`).
config.items.source: Where the SmartHomeNG items for the suggestions come from.
config.items.source.auto: `smartvisu.items.path` if set, otherwise the extension *SmartHomeNG Items*, otherwise `masteritem.json` in the pages folder
config.items.source.shngItems: Same SmartHomeNG directory and item model as the extension *SmartHomeNG Items* (`dasax.shng-items`, setting `shngItems.basePath`)
config.items.source.path: SmartHomeNG directory from `smartvisu.items.path` (items, structs and plugin structs are resolved)
config.items.source.masteritem: `masteritem.json` in the pages folder (written by the SmartHomeNG plugin smartvisu; only path and type)
config.items.path: SmartHomeNG directory (with `items/`, `structs/`, `etc/`) or its `items` folder, e.g. `\\smarthomeng\SmartHomeNG`.
config.items.typeFilter: Which items the suggestion list shows for an item parameter, by item type.
config.items.typeFilter.learned: Only types you use for this widget parameter on your pages (e.g. `basic.flip` → only `bool` items); without usage the types the widget accepts
config.items.typeFilter.widget: Types the widget accepts according to its description (`basic.flip`: `bool`, `num`, `str`)
config.items.typeFilter.off: All items (non-matching types are marked with ⚠)
config.insertParameters: Which parameters an inserted widget gets.
config.insertParameters.learned: Required parameters plus as many as you usually use for this widget on your pages, pre-filled with your most common values
config.insertParameters.required: Only up to the last required parameter
config.autoSuggest: Open the suggestions automatically when jumping to an empty placeholder (item, ID, value, table cell) with Tab.
config.suggestDetailsKeys: In the suggestion list of a smartVISU page: **→** shows the full help of the selected entry (widget documentation with preview, item details), **↑/↓** scroll it, **←** or **Esc** closes it again. Clicking the small arrow at the end of the selected entry (visible when the mouse is over it) also opens the help.
config.diagnostics: Check pages: unknown/removed widgets, number of parameters, unknown items, item types, duplicate IDs.
config.docuUrl: Link to the widget documentation. Empty (default): the documentation that comes with your smartVISU installation (`…/index.php?pages=docu`), if it can be reached at `#smartvisu.url#` and matches the chosen version – otherwise docu.smartvisu.de. Own template with placeholders: `{base}` (address of the installation), `{docuVersion}` (newest version documented online ≤ chosen version), `{version}`, `{package}` (e.g. `basic`), `{widget}` (e.g. `basic.flip`), `{macro}` (e.g. `flip`).
config.language: Language of the extension's texts: `auto` = display language of VS Code.
viewsWelcome.guide: Open a smartVISU page (an HTML file from the pages folder): the guide then shows all widgets and code blocks of your smartVISU version for it.
